I.circuitDescription: H(q0); CX(q0 -> q1) Bell pair; sender applies I on q0 (sender), q1 = receiver
facts: Receiver alone: P(0) = 0.500000, P(1) = 0.500000, whatever the sender did.
Entanglement alone sends no message: the receiver's local results look the same for I, X and Z.
Comparing both logs afterwards: Z-basis bits agree with probability 1.000000, X-basis bits with probability 1.000000.
That comparison needs a classical channel; it is the amber link, not the entanglement, that carries information.
